{{2024–25 Atlantic 10 men's basketball standings}}
The '''2024–25 George Washington Revolutionaries men's basketball team''' represented [[George Washington University]] during the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team, led by third-year head coach [[Chris Caputo]], played their home games at [[Charles E. Smith Center]] in [[Washington, D.C.]] as a member of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]].

==Previous season==
The [[2023–24 George Washington Colonials men's basketball team|Revolutionaries]] finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]] 15–17, with a 4–14 record in [[2023–24 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in last place.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://atlantic10.com/standings.aspx?standings=156|title=2023-24 Men's Basketball Standings|work=Atlantic 10|access-date=July 7, 2024|language=en}}</ref> They lost to [[2023–24 La Salle Explorers men's basketball team|La Salle]] in the first round of the [[2024 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://gwsports.com/news/2024/3/12/mens-basketball-drops-heartbreaker-at-a-10-championship|title=Men's Basketball Drops Heartbreaker at A-10 Championship|work=George Washington University Athletics|access-date=July 7, 2024|language=en}}</ref>
